% head
% One panel: one PGFPlots axis over the sensor with the panel's image. Its width is \rcpanelwidth (\linewidth when the
% host does not define it), the baseline the axis' centre; \rcfigdir is the figure's folder as the host document sees it.
\providecommand{\rcfigdir}{src/fig}%
\providecommand{\rcpanelwidth}{\linewidth}%
\begin{tikzpicture}[baseline=(current axis.center)]
\begin{axis}[
  scale only axis, width=\rcpanelwidth, height=0.75000*\rcpanelwidth,
  grid=none, log ticks with fixed point, tick label style={font=\scriptsize}, label style={font=\small}, legend cell align=left, legend style={font=\scriptsize, draw=none, fill=none},
  xmin=0, xmax=4000, ymin=0, ymax=3000, enlargelimits=false,
  xtick=\empty, ytick=\empty, axis on top, axis line style={draw=none}]
\addplot graphics[xmin=0, xmax=4000, ymin=0, ymax=3000] {\rcfigdir/fig/a.png};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}%
